notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed Bluetooth connection for players who couldn't connect after the last update.

notes.title: Update For Bug Fixes and new features
notes.notes:
1. Improved Bluetooth connection with cadence sensors. More reliable sensor connection. Small bugs like sensors not showing up in the UI or wrong connection states are currently fixed.
2. Fixed rendering issue for UI. Elements that are not part of the UI will not be rendered on top of it anymore now.
3. Added a cool feature where some landmarks have a video explanation for it. this feature needs to be enabled from the in-game menu. we can now learn more about the history and current state of the places that we are riding towards.
4. Moved the recalibrate button to be at eye-level. This would solve the issue of some people not being able to calibrate the ship properly.

notes.title: Patch for longitude and latitude fix (map not visible error for some countries)
notes.notes: fixed fractions format for different countries(comma vs period) for long and lat values, so players in for example Germany can see map being loaded correctly.

notes.title: Update release note for 10/3
notes.notes:
1. Fixed scan button menu selection bug
2. Fixed built-in POI non-english name display
3. Fixed Oculus controller support problem. Since the Oculus controller has different button set compared to the Vive controller. Now the Y button is mapped for the in game menu, the X button is for hiding the POI display name.

notes.title: Game Updates
notes.notes:
1. New locations added: Disney World, Sydney, Olso Norway
2. Updated built-in Points of Interests list for New York, Paris, San Francisco, Seattle and Disney World
3. Menu improvements: controller laser pointer effects,  location list not scrollable when clicking on location bug,
4. Game freeze bugs 
5. Display closest POI first when toggling between built-in POI list

Sneak peak: fix for Oculus controllers coming soon, hopefully next week.

notes.title: Fixed poi scanning bugs and added collision detection
notes.notes:
1. Fixed poi scanning bugs
2. added ship collision detection with buildings and ground
